name: Nishino Fuuka
source:
The sole heroine of the story. The wife of the protagonist, and a childhood friend of both of the brothers. She has been closely supporting the protagonist ever since he lost his parents as a child. She worked as a miko before their marriage, and afterwards took over the administrative duties of the shrine.
She truly loves children and she often plays with the local kids on the shrine grounds. She really looks forward to having her own children.
She is very sensitive and moans loudly. Her husband is the only man she has ever been with.
